BL-2035 — The land step reads a pole row's disposition, not its note - land_step_lib.bb's suite-poles retirable?-fn keeps a row whose line matches 'accepted pole', while BL-1629's disposition column decides accepted-ness for the budget check, so the two readers of one rule can disagree
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A follow-up the architect raised on BL-1629's pass. No choice is posed. FIRM: the land step and the budget check read a pole row's disposition by ONE rule (the fifth field is a disposition only when it is exactly owned or accepted; otherwise the row is owned), and only an accepted row is kept by it…
BL-2035 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-2035" (or "reject BL-2035 <reason>") to act.
